images.alt_en: Illustration inspired by the story: Ostrava Vell was a mountain town of four thousand people, one church with a tower too large for it, and, since the second week of September, forty-one children who coughed in the evenings.
images.alt_sl: Ilustracija po zgodbi: Ostrava Vell je bilo gorsko mesto s štiri tisoč prebivalci, eno cerkvijo s prevelikim zvonikom in, od drugega tedna septembra, enainštiridesetimi otroki, ki so ob večerih kašljali.
